title: Karibu Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Karibu is a 1.00 bedroom, 1.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Charming Seaside Guest Cottage Near the BeachKaribu is the delightful guest home of Hakuna Matata, perfectly positioned near Seaside’s West Side Pool and just a two-minute walk to the beach. Privately accessed via one of Seaside’s iconic pedestrian footpaths, this hidden retreat offers both convenience and tranquility in one of Seaside, Florida’s most desirable locations.Light-Filled Living with Private CourtyardUpon arrival, Karibu opens into a quaint, enclosed courtyard featuring a barbecue grill—an inviting space for outdoor dining or unwinding after a day at the beach. The covered front porch stretches the length of the home and leads directly into the open living area, where natural light pours in through three sets of French doors on each level.The main living space is thoughtfully designed with a queen-sized sleeper sofa, flat-screen TV, and easy access to a half bath, making it both comfortable and functional for relaxing or entertaining.Fully Equipped Kitchen & Casual DiningThe kitchen is fully equipped with everything needed for preparing meals at home and is seamlessly connected to the living space by a breakfast bar with seating for four. A washer and dryer are conveniently tucked into a kitchen closet, while a charming rocking chair positioned by the French doors creates the perfect morning coffee nook.Private King Suite with BalconyUpstairs, guests will find a bright and spacious king bedroom with an ensuite bathroom. Both the bedroom and bath open through French doors onto a private second-floor balcony, offering a peaceful outdoor escape surrounded by Seaside’s signature architecture and greenery.Ideal for Couples or Small FamiliesWhether you’re planning a romantic Seaside getaway or need additional space alongside the main home, Karibu provides a welcoming and well-appointed retreat just steps from the beach, pools, and town amenities. With its prime location, thoughtful layout, and abundant natural light, Karibu is truly a hidden gem in Seaside, Florida.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESFeatures 672 square feetPrivate Seaside residential beach access at Odessa PavilionSeaside offers the largest private residential beach on 30A176 yards or a 2-minute walk to beach accessAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 Pickleball courts, and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedOne parking pass issued for one-bedroom homesGolf carts are considered vehicles and are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside; special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002173
